notes.title: 🔥 The Glory Dungeon Raider Demo Free Update! 🔥
notes.notes:
Hey Dungeon Raiders!

We're excited to announce a free update for the demo version of The Glory Dungeon Raider! Here’s what’s new:

New Feature: Kick Monster by Rolling
Experience a dynamic new way to defeat your foes—roll and kick monsters away! Master the technique and add a fun twist to your combat strategy.

3-Stage Story Mode
Dive into a brand new story mode featuring three exciting stages. Explore new environments, uncover secrets, and challenge yourself in fresh scenarios—all available for free!

Bug Fixes & Improvements
We’ve squashed some bugs and polished the demo to ensure a smoother, more enjoyable gameplay experience.

Update your demo now and let us know what you think! Your feedback is invaluable in helping us make The Glory Dungeon Raider even more epic.

Happy raiding! ⚔️🔥
